description.en: Located in one of Zincirlikuyu's most prestigious residential developments, Soyak Soho, this exceptional front-facing residence offers breathtaking views of the Bosphorus, the 15 July Martyrs Bridge, and the Istanbul skyline. With 130 m² gross and 100 m² net living space, this spacious 2-bedroom, 1-living-room apartment features a functional layout designed for comfortable and refined urban living. The residence preserves the high-quality materials originally provided at project handover, complemented by distinctive interior architectural details. It is in excellent condition, requires no renovation, and is ready for immediate occupancy. The apartment has never been rented, allowing it to retain the care, quality, and pristine condition of a first-day residence. Residents of Soyak Soho benefit from a range of premium services and amenities, including 24/7 security, reception services, and covered parking. Its prime location provides easy access to Zorlu Center, metro stations, and Istanbul's major transportation routes, making this property an attractive opportunity for both luxury living and investment. This property qualifies for the Turkish Citizenship by Investment Program.

address: Merkez, Nakiye Elgün Sokağı 91, 34384 Şişli/Istanbul, Türkiye

description.en: The SEBA CASA Kağıthane project is a modern residential development by Seba İnşaat, located in the Kağıthane district on Istanbul's European side. This area has seen significant urban development and offers excellent connectivity to key parts of the city. Developer: Seba İnşaat, known for its high-quality constructions. Location: Merkez Mahallesi, Ceyhun Sokak, Kağıthane, Istanbul. Land Area: Approximately 5,429 to 8,000 m². Buildings: 2 residential blocks, each with 11 floors. Total Units: 144 apartments and 14 commercial units. Apartment Types: 1+1, 2+1, and 3+1 layouts, ranging from 57 to 151 m².

The project is located close to the Bosphorus, green areas, shopping centers, and major hospitals/schools. This gives it a strong everyday convenience advantage. Indoor–outdoor pools, spa, gym, landscaped areas, parking, and a full security system indicate a modern, comfortable lifestyle typical of luxury residences. The project offers large apartment layouts (3.5+1, 4.5+1, etc.), focusing on spacious living. Materials, design, and planning are oriented toward an upscale market. İstinye is already one of the more valuable and reputable neighborhoods of Istanbul. Projects here typically hold value and appeal to buyers who want exclusivity. This property qualifies for citizenship under the investment program.

Luxury Waterfront Apartment for Sale. Located in one of Bebek's most prestigious spots, right above the famous Bebek Balıkçısı, this exceptional apartment sits just below the top terrace floor of the Şevket Bey Apartment and offers uninterrupted Bosphorus views. 185 m² gross living space, 3 spacious bedrooms, 2 fully equipped bathrooms, dedicated laundry room, expansive 70 m² living room, separate kitchen and balcony, independent air conditioning in every room. This waterfront residence has been fully renovated with premium finishes, and is move-in ready. With its prime location, breathtaking views, and luxurious interior, the property offers high rental income potential and is ideal for both investment and private living.
